mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the corneas, lenses and irises was most worthwhile because the ray diagram brought their different jobs together: bending light and controlling how much enters.

leastWorthwhile.text: Attaching the completed eyes to the body was straightforward, but gave less detail about how the visual pathways connect to the brain than I hoped.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the cornea bends incoming light too, not just the lens.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary; the named slots and pictures made the fittings understandable, even if they left few choices.

continue.text: I would choose to continue, because connecting the eye parts to their functions was interesting; I would hope for more meaningful choices than simply filling the named slots.
